in_marathi.name: Bhimrao
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhimrao हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Bhima, a character in the Mahabharata, Bhimrao means the possessor of the strength of a Brahmin. Bhima was the second of the five Pandava brothers and was known for his immense strength and courage.

in_bengali.name: Bhimrao
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Brahmin strength
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhimrao একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Bhima, a character in the Mahabharata, Bhimrao means the possessor of the strength of a Brahmin. Bhima was the second of the five Pandava brothers and was known for his immense strength and courage.
